correctness.summary: The factor-two equality case is forced to be a corona by tracing equality through the half-shadowed weak-support construction behind the standard gamma_cer<=gamma+|S1| bound. Combining this with gamma<=n/2, gamma_cer!=n-1, and the known gamma_cer=n and n-2 characterizations gives the exact parity-sensitive maximum gap and all extremals. Exhaustive Graph Atlas verification through order 7 agrees.

limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge; unindexed or differently phrased equivalent results may exist.
The theorem is stated for finite simple connected graphs.
The full theorem text of the 2025 paper on trees with equal domination and certified domination numbers was not inspected.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The foundational full text gives gamma_cer<=2gamma, corona sharpness, and separate large-value characterizations, but no converse factor-two equality theorem or fixed-order maximum gap was found. The 2019 full text on gamma=gamma_cer likewise does not state these results. Later searches located algorithmic, criticality, and equality-case work but no equivalent gap theorem.

review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.

value.summary: The result sharpens a standard factor-two bound to an exact equality characterization and derives the exact maximum of gamma_cer-gamma for every connected graph order, with complete corona/diadem extremal classifications.
